profile.name: Klea Merkuri
profile.title: Product Engineer | Design Systems & Applied AI Solutions
profile.story: Software engineer in Los Angeles focused on design systems, cross-platform mobile (Flutter), and applied AI. Economics degree from UCLA (Summa Cum Laude). Currently at Finance of America; previously Experian. Builds tools including VersoID and writes about AI workflows on The Helpful Tipper.
profile.subtitle: I design and ship user-facing products — from design systems to full-stack tools I actually use.
profile.lead: Design systems, polished web experiences, high-conversion flows, and shipped products — currently at Finance of America. Before that, I led a 5K-article Gatsby migration at Experian that cut load times ~20%.
about: I'm a software engineer who likes working where product, design, and systems meet to build polished interfaces, design systems, and the tooling behind them.

I studied Economics at UCLA, then found myself increasingly drawn to the engineering side of product work. Especially in understanding how systems behave, where they break, and how to make the experience on top of them better.

At Finance of America, I own frontend experiences and design-system infrastructure across enterprise properties. Before that, at Experian, I led a headless Gatsby migration across 5,000+ blog articles — cut load times ~20% — and built interactive WebGL/Canvas experiences.

Outside work, I ship tools I actually use: VersoID, a Flutter app for managing professional personas via QR codes (live on iOS and Android), plus Chrome extensions and MCP experiments documented on The Helpful Tipper.
